verdict.rationale: AMD's own GAIA framework explicitly supports local inference, RAG, and agent tooling with hardware-accelerated performance, and the product page links to 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers,' showing a vendor AI stack targets the Ryzen line. However, there is no CPU-specific confirmation of llama.cpp, MLX, or ONNX Runtime support, and the 9950X3D is a desktop gaming-focused X3D chip without an NPU, so GAIA's hardware-accelerated claims may not map directly to this exact SKU. Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp/ONNX Runtime/MLX documentation naming this CPU, confirmation of NPU/accelerator presence on the 9950X3D, and independent benchmarks of local-AI runtimes running on this chip.
